description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) for the MADLLM model and its ablated variants across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset," lists these datasets in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "F1 Score (%)", is scaled linearly from 60 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each dataset, four bars are grouped together, representing different configurations of the MADLLM model: a green bar for "MADLLM", a purple bar for "MADLLM w/o feature embedding", a blue bar for "MADLLM w/o prompt pool", and an orange bar for "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". The approximate F1 scores for each bar are as follows: for SMD, the green bar is at ~93%, the purple bar at ~91%, the blue bar at ~91%, and the orange bar at ~91%; for PSM, the green bar is at ~97%, the purple bar at ~96%, the blue bar at ~77%, and the orange bar at ~95%; for SWaT, the green bar is at ~91%, the purple bar at ~90%, the blue bar at ~82%, and the orange bar at ~85%; for SMAP, the green bar is at ~93%, the purple bar at ~69%, the blue bar at ~69%, and the orange bar at ~67%; for MSL, the green bar is at ~87%, the purple bar at ~85%, the blue bar at ~69%, and the orange bar at ~85%; for WADI, the green bar is at ~73%, the purple bar at ~61%, the blue bar at ~63%, and the orange bar at ~68%. The bars are not sorted by value and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color coding.
